from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Party(BaseModel):
    """A named individual or entity involved in the legal proceedings."""
    role: str | None = Field(description="Role in the case, e.g. Appellant, Respondent, Plaintiff")
    name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the party")

class CaseCitation(BaseModel):
    """A court case number and associated court name."""
    court: str | None = Field(description="Name of the court")
    number: str | None = Field(description="Official case citation number")

class RulingItem(BaseModel):
    """A specific order, decision, or outcome detail from the judgment."""
    action_type: str | None = Field(description="The nature of the ruling, e.g. 'Maintain', 'Revoke', 'Compensate'")
    description: str | None = Field(description="Details of the action or order")
    amount: float | None = Field(description="Monetary amount involved, if any")
    currency: str | None = Field(description="Currency, e.g., CNY")
    percentage: float | None = Field(description="Percentage or share allocated, if any")
    instruction: str | None = Field(description="Specific instruction given (e.g. 'stop infringement', 'pay loan')")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    parties: list[Party]
    citations: list[CaseCitation]
    rulings: list[RulingItem]
    case_categories: list[str]
